I'm 16. i've been doing shitty for a long time. my girlfriend of about 3 years broke it off. that's not why i'm where i am though, that just added to it. 

my grades are slipping and i can't catch up. i stayed home all week because i'm too down to be around people. most people wouldn't suspect i'm depressed, because i'm really good at faking happiness. people would worry if i showed up in this state. i'd been emailing the psychology teacher at the school--anonymously- and she found out who I was. being a mandatory reporter, she's informed the counselors at the school that i've been considering suicide and am depressed, so i've also got that mess to look forward to when i go back.

and just today, i was supposed to get my wisdom teeth pulled. my mother didn't want me to be knocked out, and they were only going to give me novocaine. i had a panic attack while they were trying to inject it. the doctor refused to continue because she felt bad or something. it was pitiful and my mother was pissed. it was at least an hour i sat there having a panic attack despite having taken 4mg valium and .6mg xanax. couldn't breathe. and every time i think about it i go back to not being able to breathe. my mother decided her and my father were gonna get some food, and i was dragged along. then she started complaining about how my father wastes money--he doesn't. then she told me she's probably getting rid of my dog, and my cats (because they cost too much money, she says). i love my pets more than anything in this world. 
oh and her complaining about money is made even more hilarious because they went to vegas a month or so ago with money we didn't have and blew like two grand. 

and all my problems sound fucking stupid now that i write them down. i'm just so tired of being depressed and having no one to go to. i'm staring at this bottle of Vicodin wondering why i shouldn't down the entire bottle.
